<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>THIS SENIOR CREDIT</B> <B>AGREEMENT </B>(this &#8220;<B><I>Credit Agreement</I></B>&#8221;) is dated as of September&nbsp;30, 2026 by and
among (i)<B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&nbsp;G-INFRA</FONT></B> <B>LP</B>, a Delaware limited partnership (the &#8220;<B><I>Borrower</I></B>&#8221;), (ii) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> AM Private Investments LP, a Delaware
limited partnership (the &#8220;<B><I>Direct Infrastructure Account Pledgor</I></B>&#8221;), (iii) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> XIG US Investments (DCB) LLC, a Delaware limited liability company,
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(iv)&nbsp;G-Infra</FONT> XIG <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-US</FONT> Investments (FCB) LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership, acting by its general partner,
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-INFRA</FONT> GP ADVISORS LLC (the &#8220;<B><I>General Partner</I></B>&#8221;) (the entities in clauses (iii)&nbsp;and (iv), the &#8220;<B><I>Secondaries Account Pledgors</I></B>&#8221;), (v) <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> XIG US Investments (DCB) AB LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;<B><I>Delaware Issuer</I></B>&#8221;), (vi) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> XIG <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-US</FONT> Investments (FCB) AB LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership, acting by its general partner, the General Partner, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(vii)&nbsp;G-Infra</FONT> XIG <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-US</FONT> Investments (FCB) II AB LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership, acting by its general partner, the General Partner (the entities in clauses (vi)&nbsp;and (vii), the &#8220;<B><I>Cayman
Issuers</I></B>&#8221;), (viii) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> XIG US Credit Investments AB LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;<B><I>Issuer Pledgor</I></B>&#8221;), (ix)
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> Liquidity Investments LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership, acting by its general partner, the General Partner (the &#8220;<B><I>Liquid Asset Account Pledgor</I></B>&#8221;), and
(x)<B>&nbsp;SOCI&Eacute;T&Eacute; G&Eacute;N&Eacute;RALE</B>, as Administrative Agent (hereinafter defined), Calculation Agent (hereinafter defined), the Arranger and a Lender, and each of the other Persons from time to time party hereto as Lenders
(each capitalized term not defined is defined below). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>RECITALS: </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A. The Borrower has requested that the Lenders provide credit to the Borrower in the form of revolving loans on the terms and conditions set
forth herein; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">B. The Lenders are willing to make Loans (as hereinafter defined) upon the terms and subject to the conditions set
forth in this Credit Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the mutual promises herein contained and for other valuable
consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto do hereby agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;1. DEFINITIONS
</B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.1 <B>Defined Terms</B>. For the purposes of this Credit Agreement, unless otherwise expressly defined, the following terms shall
have the respective meanings assigned to them in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.1</U> or in the section or recital referred to: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Account Control Agreement</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect to any Collateral Account, each securities account control agreement
and/or deposit account control agreement (or similarly titled agreement) among (x)&nbsp;the applicable Account Pledgor, (y)&nbsp;the Administrative Agent on behalf of the Secured Parties and (z)&nbsp;the applicable depositary bank or securities
intermediary with respect to such account, providing for springing control of the applicable account in favor of the Administrative Agent, each as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Account Pledge Agreement</I></B>&#8221; means each New York law governed pledge
agreement dated on or about the date of this Credit Agreement, substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">C-1</FONT></U> or <U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">C-2</FONT></U> hereto, and granted by the applicable
Account Pledgor as pledgor in favor of the Administrative Agent as pledgee in respect of the Collateral Account(s) relating to such Account Pledgor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Account Pledgor</I></B>&#8221; means each of (i)&nbsp;the Borrower, (ii)&nbsp;the Liquid Asset Account Pledgor, (iii)&nbsp;the
Direct Infrastructure Account Pledgor, (iv)&nbsp;the Secondaries Account Pledgors and (v)&nbsp;the Issuers. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Adjusted EURIBOR
Rate</I></B>&#8221; means, for any Loan, for any Interest Period therefor, the rate per annum (rounded upwards, if necessary, to the nearest 1/100 of 1%) determined by the Lender to be equal to the quotient obtained by dividing: (i)&nbsp;the EURIBOR
Rate for such Loan for such Interest Period by (ii)&nbsp;one (1) minus the EURIBOR Reserve Requirement for such Loan for such Interest Period; <I>provided</I> that if the Adjusted EURIBOR Rate as so determined would be less than zero, such rate
shall be deemed zero for purposes of this Credit Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Adjusted Liquid Asset NAV</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect to
each Eligible Investment that constitutes a Liquid Asset Investment, as of any date of determination, the Borrower&#8217;s Proportionate Share of the NAV of such Eligible Investment, as adjusted (but without duplication of any adjustments or
reductions set forth in the definition of &#8220;NAV&#8221;) for (A)&nbsp;any Write-Down Valuation or Appraisal Adjustment of such Eligible Investment occurring on or prior to such date; (B)&nbsp;the exclusion of or decrease in value of such
Eligible Investment with respect to which a Material Investment Event has occurred on or prior to such date (as required by the definition of the term Material Investment Event); and (C)&nbsp;any reduction due to the Concentration Limit (provided
that only that portion of such Eligible Investment in excess of the Concentration Limit shall be excluded for purposes of the calculation of the Borrowing Base). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Administrative Agent</I></B>&#8221; means Soci&eacute;t&eacute; G&eacute;n&eacute;rale until the appointment of a successor
&#8220;Administrative Agent&#8221; pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;11.9</U> and, thereafter, shall mean such successor Administrative Agent. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Affected Financial Institution</I></B>&#8221; means (a)&nbsp;any EEA Financial Institution or (b)&nbsp;any UK Financial
Institution. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Affiliate</I></B>&#8221; of any Person means any other Person that, directly or indirectly, controls or is
controlled by, or is under common control with, such Person. For the purpose of this definition, &#8220;control&#8221; and the correlative meanings of the terms &#8220;controlled by&#8221; and &#8220;under common control with&#8221; means the
possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a Person, whether through the ownership of voting shares or partnership interests or by contract or otherwise. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Agency Services Address</I></B>&#8221; means the address for the Administrative Agent set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.6</U>, or such other address as may be identified by written notice from the Administrative Agent to the Borrower and the Lenders. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Agent-Related Person</I></B>&#8221; is defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;11.3</U>. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Agents</I></B>&#8221; means, collectively, the Administrative Agent, the
Calculation Agent, the Arrangers and any successors and assigns in such capacities. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Aggregate BSL NAV</I></B>&#8221; means
the aggregate NAV of all Eligible Investments that are Broadly Syndicated Loans. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Alternate Base Rate</I></B>&#8221; means,
for any day, a rate per annum equal to the greatest of (a)&nbsp;the Prime Rate in effect on such day, (b)&nbsp;the Federal Funds Rate in effect on such day plus <SUP STYLE="vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&#8260;<SUB STYLE="vertical-align:bottom">2</SUB>
of 1% and (c)&nbsp;Term SOFR for a one month tenor (determined as of the Reference Time with respect to such date) plus 1%. Any change in the Alternate Base Rate due to a change in the Prime Rate, the Federal Funds Rate or Term SOFR shall be
effective from and including the effective date of such change in the Prime Rate, the Federal Funds Rate or Term SOFR, respectively. If the Alternate Base Rate is being used as an alternate rate of interest pursuant to
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3</U> (for the avoidance of doubt, only until the Benchmark Replacement has been determined pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3</U>), then the Alternate Base Rate shall be the greater of <U>clauses
(a)</U>&nbsp;and <U>(b)</U> above and shall be determined without reference to <U>clause (c)</U>&nbsp;above. For the avoidance of doubt, if the Alternate Base Rate as determined pursuant to the foregoing would be less than zero, such rate shall be
deemed to be zero for purposes of this Credit Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Alternate Base Rate Conversion Date</I></B>&#8221; is defined in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.3(g)</U><I>.</I> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Alternate Base Rate Loan</I></B>&#8221; means a Loan made hereunder with
respect to which the interest rate is calculated by reference to the Alternate Base Rate. All Alternate Base Rate Loans shall be denominated in Dollars. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Anti-Corruption Laws</I></B>&#8221; means all laws, rules, and regulations of any jurisdiction applicable to the Credit Parties
from time to time concerning or relating to bribery or corruption. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Applicable Asset Advance Rate</I></B>&#8221; means, with
respect to any Direct Infrastructure Investment as of any date of determination, the percentage set forth below opposite the range within which the Asset LTV of such Direct Infrastructure Investment falls as of such date: </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Appraisal Adjustment</I></B>&#8221; is defined in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.15(b)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Approved Cure Plan</I></B>&#8221; is defined in the definition of &#8220;Cure
Plan&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Approved Fund</I></B>&#8221; means any Person (other than a natural person) that is (or will be) engaged in
making, purchasing, holding or otherwise investing in commercial loans and similar extensions of credit in the ordinary course of its business, that is administered or managed by: (a)&nbsp;a Lender or (b)&nbsp;an Affiliate of a Lender. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Approved Valuation Agent</I></B>&#8221; means Greenhill&nbsp;&amp; Co., Houlihan Lokey, Alvarez&nbsp;&amp; Marsal, Hilco,
Jefferies LLC or PJT Partners LP and affiliates of each of the foregoing (or such other industry recognized third-party agent acceptable to the Borrower and the Calculation Agent, each in its reasonable discretion). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Arranger</I></B>&#8221; means each of Soci&eacute;t&eacute; G&eacute;n&eacute;rale, as lead arranger, and any other Lenders
approved as such by the Borrower and the Arrangers, each in its sole discretion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Article 55 BRRD</I></B>&#8221; means
Article 55 of Directive 2014/59/EU establishing a framework for the recovery and resolution of credit institutions and investment firms. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Asset LTV</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect to any Direct Infrastructure Investment as of any date of determination, the ratio
(expressed as a percentage) of: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) the sum, without duplication, of all Indebtedness (other than the Obligations) attributable to such
Direct Infrastructure Investment, determined on a combined, look-through basis and including, without limitation: (i)&nbsp;all Indebtedness of such Direct Infrastructure Investment itself; (ii)&nbsp;all Indebtedness of the Holding Company (if any)
in respect of such Direct Infrastructure Investment and any Subsidiary of such Holding Company; and (iii)&nbsp;the Allocable Share of any Fund-Level Debt; to </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) the gross fair market value of such Direct Infrastructure Investment (determined in accordance with the Borrower&#8217;s valuation policy
and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, without deduction for Indebtedness), in each case as of such date of determination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For
purposes of <U>clause (a)(iii)</U> above, &#8220;<B><I>Fund-Level Debt</I></B>&#8221; means any Indebtedness (other than the Obligations) that is recourse, directly or indirectly, to obligors that directly or indirectly own or hold any Direct
Infrastructure Investment (provided that, for the avoidance of doubt, Fund-Level Debt shall include Direct Infrastructure Intermediate Entity Debt); and the &#8220;<B><I>Allocable Share</I></B>&#8221; of any Fund-Level Debt attributable to a given
Direct Infrastructure Investment is the amount of such Fund-Level Debt multiplied by a fraction, the numerator of which is the gross fair market value of such Direct Infrastructure Investment and the denominator of which is the aggregate gross fair
market value of all Direct Infrastructure Investments to which such Fund-Level Debt is recourse, in each case as of the applicable date of determination. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Assignee</I></B>&#8221; is defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.11(c)</U>. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Assignment and Acceptance Agreement</I></B>&#8221; means the agreement
contemplated by <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.11(c)</U>, pursuant to which any Lender assigns all or any portion of its rights and obligations hereunder, which agreement shall be substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit G</U> attached hereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Available Loan Amount</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect to any Tranche at any time, the lesser of (a)&nbsp;the applicable
Maximum Tranche Commitment and (b)&nbsp;(i) with respect to the Liquid Asset Tranche, the Liquid Asset Tranche Borrowing Base and (ii)&nbsp;with respect to the Private Asset Tranche, the Private Asset Tranche Borrowing Base. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Available Tenor</I></B>&#8221; means, as of any date of determination and with respect to the then-current Benchmark, as
applicable, any tenor for such Benchmark or payment period for interest calculated with reference to such Benchmark, as applicable, that is or may be used for determining the length of an Interest Period pursuant to this Credit Agreement as of such
date and not including, for the avoidance of doubt, any tenor for such Benchmark that is then-removed from the definition of &#8220;Interest Period&#8221; pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3(f)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Bail-In</FONT> Action</I></B>&#8221; means the exercise of any Write-Down and Conversion Powers
by the applicable Resolution Authority in respect of any liability of an Affected Financial Institution. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Bail-In</FONT> Legislation</I></B>&#8221;<I> </I>means (a)&nbsp;with respect to any EEA Member Country implementing Article 55 BRRD of the European Parliament and of the Council of the European Union, the implementing law,
regulation rule or requirement for such EEA Member Country from time to time which is described in the EU <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Bail-In</FONT> Legislation Schedule and (b)&nbsp;with respect to the United Kingdom, Part I of the United
Kingdom Banking Act 2009 (as amended from time to time) and any other law, regulation or rule applicable in the United Kingdom relating to the resolution of unsound or failing banks, investment firms or other financial institutions or their
affiliates (other than through liquidation, administration or other insolvency proceedings). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark</I></B>&#8221; means,
initially, (a)&nbsp;with respect to Loans denominated in Dollars, Term SOFR and (b)&nbsp;with respect to Loans denominated in Euros, the Adjusted EURIBOR Rate; <U>provided</U> that if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark
Replacement Date have occurred with respect to Term SOFR, the Adjusted EURIBOR Rate or the then-current Benchmark, then &#8220;Benchmark&#8221; means the applicable Benchmark Replacement to the extent that such Benchmark Replacement has replaced
such prior benchmark rate pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3(c)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Conversion Date</I></B>&#8221; is
defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.3(g)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Rate Loan</I></B>&#8221; means a Loan made hereunder with
respect to which the interest rate is calculated by reference to the Benchmark. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Replacement</I></B><I>&#8221;
</I>means, for any Available Tenor, the first alternative set forth in the order below that can be determined by the Administrative Agent for the applicable Benchmark Replacement Date: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1) in case of Loans denominated in Dollars: the sum of (a)&nbsp;Daily Simple SOFR and (b)&nbsp;the related Benchmark
Replacement Adjustment; or </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2) the sum of: (a)&nbsp;the alternate benchmark rate that has been selected
by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower as the replacement for the then-current Benchmark for the applicable Corresponding Tenor giving due consideration to (i)&nbsp;any selection or recommendation of a replacement benchmark rate or the
mechanism for determining such a rate by the Relevant Governmental Body or (ii)&nbsp;any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for determining a benchmark rate as a replacement for the then-current Benchmark for U.S. dollar-denominated
syndicated credit facilities at such time and (b)&nbsp;the related Benchmark Replacement Adjustment; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>provided</U> that
if the Benchmark Replacement as determined pursuant to <U>clause (1)</U>&nbsp;or <U>(2)</U> above would be less than zero, the Benchmark Replacement will be deemed to be zero for the purposes of this Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Replacement Adjustment</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect to any replacement of the then-current Benchmark with an
Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement for any applicable Interest Period and Available Tenor for any setting of such Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement, the spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment (which may be a
positive or negative value or zero) that has been selected by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower for the applicable Corresponding Tenor giving due consideration to (i)&nbsp;any selection or recommendation of a spread adjustment, or method for
calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of such Benchmark with the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement by the Relevant Governmental Body on the applicable Benchmark Replacement Date or (ii)&nbsp;any evolving or
then-prevailing market convention for determining a spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of such Benchmark with the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement for U.S.
dollar-denominated syndicated credit facilities. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes</I></B>&#8221; means, with respect
to any Benchmark Replacement, any technical, administrative or operational changes (including changes to the definition of &#8220;Alternate Base Rate,&#8221; the definition of &#8220;Central Bank Rate&#8221;, the definition of &#8220;Business
Day,&#8221; the definition of &#8220;Interest Period,&#8221; the timing and frequency of determining rates and making payments of interest, the timing of borrowing requests or prepayment, conversion or continuation notices, the length of lookback
periods, the applicability of breakage provisions, and other technical, administrative or operational matters) that the Administrative Agent (in consultation with the Borrower) decides may be appropriate to reflect the adoption and implementation of
such Benchmark Replacement and to permit the administration thereof by the Administrative Agent in a manner substantially consistent with market practice (or, if the Administrative Agent decides that adoption of any portion of such market practice
is not administratively feasible or if the Administrative Agent determines that no market practice for the administration of such Benchmark Replacement exists, in such other manner of administration as the Administrative Agent (in consultation with
the Borrower) decides is reasonably necessary in connection with the administration of this Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">7 </P>

<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Replacement Date</I></B>&#8221; means the earliest to occur of the
following events with respect to the then-current Benchmark: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1) in the case of <U>clause (1)</U>&nbsp;or <U>(2)</U> of
the definition of &#8220;Benchmark Transition Event,&#8221; the later of (a)&nbsp;the date of the public statement or publication of information referenced therein and (b)&nbsp;the date on which the administrator of such Benchmark (or the published
component used in the calculation thereof) permanently or indefinitely ceases to provide all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2) in the case of clause (3)&nbsp;of the definition of &#8220;Benchmark Transition Event,&#8221; the date of the public
statement or publication of information referenced therein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For the avoidance of doubt, (i)&nbsp;if the event giving rise
to the Benchmark Replacement Date occurs on the same day as, but earlier than, the Reference Time in respect of any determination, the Benchmark Replacement Date will be deemed to have occurred prior to the Reference Time for such determination and
(ii)&nbsp;the &#8220;Benchmark Replacement Date&#8221; will be deemed to have occurred in the case of <U>clause (1)</U>&nbsp;or <U>(2)</U> with respect to any Benchmark upon the occurrence of the applicable event or events set forth therein with
respect to all then-current Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Transition Event</I></B>&#8221; means the occurrence of one or more of the following events with respect to the
then-current Benchmark: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1) a public statement or publication of information by or on behalf of the administrator of such
Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof) announcing that such administrator has ceased or will cease to provide all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof), permanently or indefinitely,
<U>provided</U> that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide any Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark (or
the published component used in the calculation thereof), the Federal Reserve Board, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, an insolvency official with jurisdiction over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such component), a resolution authority
with jurisdiction over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such component) or a court or an entity with similar insolvency or resolution authority over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such component), in each case which states that the
administrator of such Benchmark (or such component) has ceased or will cease to provide all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) permanently or indefinitely, <U>provided</U> that, at the time of such statement or
publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide any Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(3) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark (or
the published component used in the calculation thereof) announcing that all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) are no longer representative. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">8 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For the avoidance of doubt, a Benchmark Transition Event will be deemed to have occurred
with respect to any Benchmark if a public statement or publication of information set forth above has occurred with respect to each then-current Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Unavailability Period</I></B>&#8221; means the period (if any)&nbsp;(x) beginning at the time that a Benchmark
Replacement Date has occurred if, at such time, no Benchmark Replacement has replaced the then-current Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3</U> and (y)&nbsp;ending at
the time that a Benchmark Replacement has replaced the then-current Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Beneficial Ownership Certification</I></B>&#8221; means a certification regarding beneficial ownership as required by the
Beneficial Ownership Regulation, which certification shall be substantially similar in form and substance to the form of Certification Regarding Beneficial Owners of Legal Entity Customers published jointly, in May 2018, by the Loan Syndications and
Trading Association and Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Beneficial Ownership
Regulation</I></B>&#8221; means 31 C.F.R. &#167; 1010.230. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>&#8220;Benefit Plan&#8221;</I></B> means any of (a)&nbsp;an
&#8220;employee benefit plan&#8221; (as defined in ERISA) that is subject to Section&nbsp;406 of Title I of ERISA, (b)&nbsp;a &#8220;plan&#8221; as defined in Section&nbsp;4975 of the Internal Revenue Code or (c)&nbsp;any Person whose assets include
(for purposes of ERISA Section&nbsp;3(42) or otherwise for purposes of Title I of ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the Internal Revenue Code) the assets of any such &#8220;employee benefit plan&#8221; or &#8220;plan&#8221;. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrower</I></B>&#8221; is defined in the first paragraph hereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrower Expense</I></B>&#8221; means any operating expense of the Borrower incurred in the ordinary course of the
Borrower&#8217;s activities pursuant to and in compliance with its Operating Agreement and this Credit Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrower
Party</I></B>&#8221; is defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;11.1(a)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrower&#8217;s Proportionate
Share</I></B>&#8221; means, in respect of each Portfolio Investment directly or indirectly held by the Borrower or an Intermediate Entity, the portion thereof attributable to the economic interest of the Borrower in such Portfolio Investment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrowing</I></B>&#8221; means a disbursement made by the Lenders of any of the proceeds of one or more Loans, and
&#8220;<B><I>Borrowings</I></B>&#8221; means the plural thereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrowing Base</I></B>&#8221; means the Liquid Asset
Tranche Borrowing Base, the Private Asset Tranche Borrowing Base, or either or both of them, as the context shall require. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Borrowing Base Certificate</I></B>&#8221; means the spreadsheet substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> hereto setting
forth the calculation of (x)&nbsp;the Private Asset Tranche Borrowing Base and (y)&nbsp;the LTV Ratio, which shall be provided in Microsoft Excel format. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">9 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Broadly Syndicated Loan</I></B>&#8221; means a senior loan obligation that is
broadly syndicated and traded in the secondary loan market. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Broadly Syndicated Loan Eligibility Criteria</I></B>&#8221;
means, with respect to any Liquid Asset Investment that is a Broadly Syndicated Loan, each of the following criteria: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">such Broadly Syndicated Loan is a Senior Secured Loan or a Second Lien Loan, provided that no more than 10.0%
of the Aggregate BSL NAV may consist of Second Lien Loans; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">at all times: (a)&nbsp;no payment default or event of default with respect to such Broadly Syndicated Loan has
occurred and is continuing; (b)&nbsp;the Broadly Syndicated Loan Obligor of such Broadly Syndicated Loan is not the subject of any bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, reorganization or similar proceeding; and (c)&nbsp;such Broadly Syndicated Loan
has not been accelerated, restructured (including pursuant to any distressed debt exchange) or written off (in whole or in part) by the holder thereof; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the outstanding principal amount of such Broadly Syndicated Loan is not less than $150,000,000;
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iv)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the aggregate principal amount of all Indebtedness outstanding with respect to the Broadly Syndicated Loan
Obligor of such Broadly Syndicated Loan is not less than $350,000,000; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(v)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the Broadly Syndicated Loan Obligor (or principal guarantor of such Broadly Syndicated Loan) is organized and
incorporated in the United States (such Broadly Syndicated Loan, a &#8220;<B>U.S. BSL</B>&#8221;), Canada, United Kingdom, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, France, Denmark, Netherlands or Ireland, provided that no less than 80.0% of the Aggregate BSL
NAV shall consist of U.S. BSLs; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(vi)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">such Broadly Syndicated Loan is publicly rated with a rating of at least
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;B-&#8221;</FONT> by S&amp;P, &#8220;B3&#8221; by Moody&#8217;s or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;B-&#8221;</FONT> by Fitch; notwithstanding the foregoing, no more than 15.0% of Aggregate BSL NAV may
consist of Broadly Syndicated Loans that have a rating below the foregoing thresholds but not lower than &#8220;CCC&#8221; by S&amp;P or Fitch, or &#8220;Caa2&#8221; by Moody&#8217;s, in each case determined as of the date of acquisition thereof;
provided further, that if the rating of any Broadly Syndicated Loan declines below &#8220;CCC&#8221; by S&amp;P or Fitch, or &#8220;Caa2&#8221; by Moody&#8217;s after the date of acquisition thereof, such Broadly Syndicated Loan may remain as an
&#8220;Eligible Investment&#8221; but shall be subject to the applicable advance rates as set forth in the definition of &#8220;Applicable BSL Advance Rate&#8221;; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(vii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">such Broadly Syndicated Loan shall have observable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">bid-side</FONT> quotes from
at least two (2)&nbsp;Nationally Recognized Pricing Providers; provided that no more than 15.0% of Aggregate BSL NAV may consist of Broadly Syndicated Loans that have observable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">bid-side</FONT> quotes from only one
(1)&nbsp;Nationally Recognized Pricing Provider, and provided, further, that any such Broadly Syndicated Loan with fewer than three (3)&nbsp;observable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">bid-side</FONT> quotes shall be subject to the applicable
advance rate reduction set forth in the definition of &#8220;Applicable BSL Advance Rate&#8221;; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">10 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(viii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">mid-market</FONT> price of such Broadly Syndicated Loan as of the
applicable trade date (as determined by reference to LoanX <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Mark-It</FONT> Partners or the Loan Pricing Corporation) is not less than 70% of par; provided that, no more than 10.0% of the Aggregate BSL NAV may consist
of Broadly Syndicated Loan that are quoted below 80% of par; provided, further, that any Broadly Syndicated Loan with a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">mid-market</FONT> price (x)&nbsp;below 90% of par (but equal to or greater than 80% of par) or
(y)&nbsp;below 80% of par shall, in each case, be subject to the applicable advance rate reduction set forth in the definition of &#8220;Applicable BSL Advance Rate&#8221;; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the stated maturity of such Broadly Syndicated Loan does not exceed eight (8)&nbsp;years from the date of
origination thereof; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>

except: (a)&nbsp;a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks in the State of New York or the United Kingdom are authorized or required by law to close; (b)&nbsp;if such day relates to any interest rate settings as to a Benchmark Rate
Loan denominated in Dollars, any fundings, disbursements, settlements and payments in Dollars in respect of any such Benchmark Rate Loan, or any other dealings to be carried out pursuant to this Credit Agreement in respect of any such Benchmark Rate
Loan (or any Alternate Base Rate Loan as to which the interest rate is determined by reference to SOFR), any day on which the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association recommends that the fixed income departments of its members be closed
for the entire day for purposes of trading in United States government securities; and (c)&nbsp;if such day relates to any interest rate settings as to a Loan denominated in Euros, any fundings, disbursements, settlements and payments in Euro in

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>CBR Loan</I></B>&#8221; means a Loan that bears interest at a rate determined
by reference to the Central Bank Rate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Central Bank Rate</I></B>&#8221; means, (A)&nbsp;the greater of (i)&nbsp;for any Loan
denominated in Euros, one of the following three rates as may be selected by the Administrative Agent in its reasonable discretion: (1)&nbsp;the fixed rate for the main refinancing operations of the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto),
or, if that rate is not published, the minimum bid rate for the main refinancing operations of the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto), each as published by the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto) from time to time,
(2)&nbsp;the rate for the marginal lending facility of the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto), as published by the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto) from time to time or (3)&nbsp;the rate for the deposit facility of the
central banking system of the Participating Member States, as published by the European Central Bank (or any successor thereto) from time to time and (ii)&nbsp;zero; plus (B)&nbsp;the applicable Central Bank Rate Adjustment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Central Bank Rate Adjustment</I></B>&#8221; means, for any day, for any Loan denominated in Euros, a rate equal to the difference
(which may be a positive or negative value or zero) of (i)&nbsp;the average of the Adjusted EURIBOR Rate for the five most recent Business Days preceding such day for which the EURIBOR Screen Rate was available (excluding, from such averaging, the
highest and the lowest Adjusted EURIBOR Rate applicable during such period of five Business Days) minus (ii)&nbsp;the Central Bank Rate in respect of Euros in effect on the last Business Day in such period. For purposes of this definition,
(x)&nbsp;the term Central Bank Rate shall be determined disregarding clause (B)&nbsp;of the definition of such term and (y)&nbsp;each of the EURIBOR Rate on any day shall be based on the EURIBOR Screen Rate on such day at approximately the time
referred to in the definition of such term for deposits in the applicable currency for a maturity of one month. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><I>Change in
Law</I></B>&#8221; means (a)&nbsp;the adoption of any Governmental Rule, Law or bank regulatory guideline after the Closing Date (or, with respect to any Person first becoming a Lender after the Closing Date, the date such Person first becomes a
Lender); (b) any change in any Governmental Rule, Law or bank regulatory guideline or any clarification or change in the interpretation, application or administration thereof by any Governmental Authority after the Closing Date (or, with respect to
any Person first becoming a Lender after the Closing Date, the date such Person first becomes a Lender); or (c)&nbsp;the making or issuance of any rule, guideline or directive (whether or not having the force of law) by any Governmental Authority
after the Closing Date (or, with respect to any Person first becoming a Lender after the Closing Date, the date such Person first becomes a Lender). </P>

(i)&nbsp;fund all or any portion of its Loans within one Business Day of the date such Loans were required to be funded hereunder unless such Lender notifies the Administrative Agent and the Borrower in writing that such failure is the result of
such Lender&#8217;s determination that one or more conditions precedent to funding (each of which conditions precedent, together with any applicable default, shall be specifically identified in such writing) has not been satisfied, or (ii)&nbsp;pay
to the Administrative Agent or any other Lender any other amount required to be paid by it hereunder within one Business Day of the date when due, (b)&nbsp;has notified the Borrower, the Administrative Agent or any Lender in writing that it does not

substantially similar to the Credit Agreement (unless such writing or public statement relates to such Lender&#8217;s obligation to fund a Loan hereunder or a loan under any such other credit agreement and states that such position is based on such
Lender&#8217;s determination that a condition precedent to funding (which condition precedent, together with any applicable default, shall be specifically identified in such writing or public statement) cannot be satisfied), (c) has failed, within
two Business Days after written request by the Administrative Agent or the Borrower, to confirm in writing to the Administrative Agent and the Borrower that it will comply with its prospective funding obligations hereunder (provided that such Lender
shall cease to be a Defaulting Lender pursuant to this clause (c)&nbsp;upon receipt of such written confirmation by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower), or (d)&nbsp;has, or has a direct or indirect parent company that has, (i)&nbsp;become the
subject of a proceeding under Debtor Relief Laws, including the appointment of a receiver, custodian, conservator, trustee, administrator, assignee for the benefit of creditors or similar Person charged with reorganization or liquidation of its
business or assets, including the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other state or federal regulatory authority acting in such a capacity or (ii)&nbsp;has, or has an indirect parent company that has, become the subject of a <FONT

Day by the NYFRB as the effective federal funds rate; <U>provided</U> that if the Federal Funds Rate as so determined would be less than zero, such rate shall be deemed to be zero for the purposes of this Credit Agreement. </P>

<U>clause (a)</U>&nbsp;above, (d) to settle or cash collateralize obligations under Hedging Agreements entered into in the ordinary course of business, (e)&nbsp;to pay interest on the Loans and (f)&nbsp;other working capital and general corporate

that to the extent that the aggregate Commitment is reduced or otherwise declines, the Commitment of each Lender shall decline based on such Lender&#8217;s Pro Rata Share; <U>provided</U>, further, that (x)&nbsp;when used in connection with
&#8220;Loans&#8221;, &#8220;Loans&#8221; or &#8220;Principal Obligations&#8221;, &#8220;Pro Rata Share&#8221; shall mean the percentage obtained from the fraction: (a)&nbsp;the numerator of which is the aggregate Loans of such Lender; and
(b)&nbsp;the denominator of which is the aggregate Loans of all Lenders and (y)&nbsp;when used in connection with &#8220;Commitments&#8221;, &#8220;Pro Rata Share&#8221; shall mean the percentage obtained from the fraction: (a)&nbsp;the numerator of
which is the aggregate Commitments of such Lender; and (b)&nbsp;the denominator of which is the aggregate Commitments of all Lenders. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;the Credit Parties (taken as a whole) do not intend to, and do not
believe that they will, incur debts or liabilities beyond their ability to pay as such debts or liabilities become absolute and matured; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;the Credit Parties are not engaged in a business or transaction, and are not about to engage in a business or
transaction, for which their assets and the unfunded capital commitments (taken as a whole, together with its Subsidiaries) would constitute unreasonably small capital; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) &#8195;the Borrower is able to pay its debts and liabilities, including contingent liabilities, as they mature in the
ordinary course of business. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For the purposes of this definition, the amount of contingent liabilities (such as litigation, guarantees,
and pension plan liabilities) at any time shall be computed as the amount which, in light of all the facts and circumstances existing at the time, represents the amount which can be reasonably expected to become an actual or matured liability. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.5&#8195;<B>Exchange Rates; Currency Equivalents</B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The Administrative Agent shall determine the Dollar Equivalent amounts of Borrowings and the Principal Obligations
denominated in Euros. Except for purposes of financial statements delivered by Credit Parties hereunder or calculating financial covenants hereunder or except as otherwise provided herein (for which the Dollar Equivalent shall be determined by the

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Wherever in this Credit Agreement in connection with a Borrowing, conversion, continuation or prepayment of a
Benchmark Rate Loan, an amount, such as a required minimum or multiple amount, is expressed in Dollars, but such Benchmark Rate Loan is denominated in Euros, such amount shall be the Dollar Equivalent of such amount (rounded to the nearest unit of
Euros, with 0.5 of a unit being rounded upward), as determined by the Administrative Agent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;The interest rate on
a Loan denominated in Dollars or Euros may be derived from an interest rate benchmark that may be discontinued or is, or may in the future become, the subject of regulatory reform. Upon the occurrence of a Benchmark Transition Event,
Section&nbsp;4.3 provides a mechanism for determining an alternative rate of interest. The Administrative Agent does not warrant or accept any responsibility for, and shall not have any liability with respect to, the administration, submission,
performance or any other matter related to any interest rate used in this Agreement, or with respect to any alternative or successor rate thereto, or replacement rate thereof, including without limitation, whether the composition or characteristics
of any such alternative, successor or replacement reference rate will be similar to, or produce the same value or economic equivalence of, the existing interest rate being replaced or have the same volume or liquidity as did any existing interest
rate prior to its discontinuance or unavailability. The Administrative Agent and its affiliates and/or other related entities may engage in transactions that affect the calculation of any interest rate used in this Agreement or any alternative,
successor or alternative rate (including any Benchmark Replacement) and/or any relevant adjustments thereto, in each case, in a manner adverse to the Borrowers. The Administrative Agent may select information sources or services in its reasonable
discretion to ascertain any interest rate used in this Agreement, any component thereof, or rates referenced in the definition thereof, in each case pursuant to the terms of this Agreement, and shall have no liability to any Borrower, any Lender or
any other person or entity for damages of any kind, including direct or indirect, special, punitive, incidental or consequential damages, costs, losses or expenses (whether in tort, contract or otherwise and whether at law or in equity), for any
error or calculation of any such rate (or component thereof) provided by any such information source or service. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.6&#8195;<B>Benchmark Notification</B>. The interest rate on any Loan may be derived from

rate (or component thereof) provided by any such information source or service. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.7&#8195;<B>Divisions</B><B>.</B> For all purposes under
the Loan Documents, in connection with any division or plan of division under Delaware law (or any comparable event under a different jurisdiction&#8217;s laws): (a) if any asset, right, obligation or liability of any Person becomes the asset,
right, obligation or liability of a different Person, then it shall be deemed to have been transferred from the original Person to the subsequent Person, and (b)&nbsp;if any new Person comes into existence, such new Person shall be deemed to have
been organized and acquired on the first date of its existence by the holders of its Equity Interests at such time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;2.&#8195;LOANS AND
COMMITMENTS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.1&#8195;<B>The Commitments.</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<B>Committed Amount.</B> Subject to the terms and conditions herein set forth, each Lender severally agrees to extend
to the Borrower Loans that are Benchmark Rate Loans (or if Term SOFR is unavailable, Alternate Base Rate Loans) under each Tranche in Dollars or Euros in an amount not to exceed its Commitment for such Tranche (subject to
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.1(b)</U>). Amounts repaid or prepaid under the revolving facility provided pursuant to this Credit Agreement may be <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">re-borrowed,</FONT> subject to the terms and conditions set forth
herein. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">41 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <B>Limitation on Borrowings</B>. Except as provided in <U>clause
(c)</U>&nbsp;below, the Lenders shall not be required to advance any applicable Loans or Rollover hereunder if: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)
immediately after giving effect to such Borrowing or Rollover, (A)&nbsp;the aggregate outstanding principal amount of Loans under the applicable Tranche would exceed the Available Loan Amount for such Tranche or (B)&nbsp;the aggregate Principal
Obligations would exceed the Maximum Commitment; <U>provided</U>, that the foregoing restriction shall apply only to the extent of the amount by which such Borrowing or Rollover would cause such excess; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) immediately after giving effect to such Borrowing (but not a Rollover), the LTV Ratio would exceed the Maximum LTV;
<U>provided</U> that the foregoing restriction shall apply only to the extent of the amount by which such Borrowing would cause the LTV Ratio to exceed the Maximum LTV; and/or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) an Event of Default or a Default exists. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <B>Exceptions to Limitations</B>. Conversions to Alternate Base Rate Loans shall be permitted in each case of
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.1(b)</U> above in the event that Benchmark Rate Loans are unavailable pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.2</U> or <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.3</U>, unless the Administrative Agent has otherwise
accelerated the Obligations or exercised other rights that terminate the Commitments under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;10.2</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <B>Mandatory Prepayment</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <B>Excess Loans Outstanding</B>. If, on any day, the aggregate amount of the Principal Obligations exceeds the Maximum
Commitment, then the Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of Lenders, in same day funds an amount equal to such excess no later than the Mandatory Prepayment End Date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <B>Maximum LTV</B>. If, on any day, the LTV Ratio exceeds the Maximum LTV in effect on such day (a &#8220;<B><I>Maximum
LTV Breach</I></B>&#8221;; and the date of such Maximum LTV Breach, the &#8220;<B><I>Determination Date</I></B>&#8221;), then the Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of Lenders, in same day funds, no later than the
Mandatory Prepayment End Date, an amount such that, immediately after giving effect to such amount paid, the LTV Ratio shall decrease to a percentage that is equal to or less than the Maximum LTV as of the applicable Determination Date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.2 <B>[Reserved]</B>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.3
<B>Manner of Borrowing.</B> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <B>Request for Borrowing</B>. The Borrower shall give the Administrative Agent notice at
the Agency Services Address of the date of each requested Borrowing hereunder, which notice may be by electronic mail (a &#8220;<B><I>Request for Borrowing</I></B>&#8221;), substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit E</U> hereto, and which notice shall
be effective upon </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">42 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
receipt by the Administrative Agent. The Request for Borrowing of Loans on any Funding Date: (i)&nbsp;shall be furnished to the Administrative Agent no later than 12:00 noon (New York
time)&nbsp;(x) in the case of a Borrowing under the Liquid Asset Tranche, at least three (3)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the requested date of the Borrowing in Dollars (or four (4)&nbsp;Business Days in the case of Borrowings in Euro) and
(y)&nbsp;in the case of a Borrowing under the Private Asset Tranche, at least five (5)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the requested date of the Borrowing in Dollars (or six (6)&nbsp;Business Days in the case of Borrowings in Euro); <I>provided</I> that
no Borrowing under the Private Asset Tranche shall be made unless the Administrative Agent shall have received the most recent Loan Tape required to be delivered pursuant to Section&nbsp;8.1(c) no later than two (2)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the
requested date of such Borrowing; <I>provided</I>, <I>further</I>, that from and after the date on which the Administrative Agent confirms in writing that it is receiving the Loan Tape on each Business Day, the notice period set forth in the
foregoing clause (y)&nbsp;shall be three (3)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the requested date of the Borrowing in Dollars (or four (4)&nbsp;Business Days in the case of Borrowings in Euro) for so long as the Loan Tape continues to be delivered on each
Business Day; and (ii)&nbsp;must specify: (A)&nbsp;the Tranche under which such Borrowing is requested, (B)&nbsp;the currency and amount of such Borrowing, which shall be denominated in Dollars or Euro, (C)&nbsp;the type of such Borrowing (which
shall be Benchmark Rate Loans), and (D)&nbsp;the date of such Borrowing, which shall be a Business Day. If the applicable Borrower fails to specify the currency of the Loans to be borrowed, the Loans so requested shall be made in Dollars. Any
Request for Borrowing received by the Administrative Agent after 12:00 noon (New York time) shall be deemed to have been given by the Borrower on the next succeeding Business Day. Each Request for Borrowing submitted by the Borrower shall be deemed
to be a representation and warranty that the conditions specified in <U>Sections 6.1</U> (with respect to any Borrowing made on the Closing Date) and <U>6.2</U><I> </I>have been satisfied on and as of the date of the applicable Borrowing. No Request
for Borrowing shall be valid hereunder for any purpose unless it shall have been accompanied or preceded by the information and other documents required to be delivered in accordance with this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.3</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <B>Further Information</B>. Each Request for Borrowing shall be accompanied or preceded by: (i)&nbsp;a Borrowing Base
Certificate dated the date of such Request for Borrowing (or, for Borrowings under the Liquid Asset Tranche, the most recent calculation of the Liquid Asset Tranche Borrowing Base and a calculation of the LTV Ratio); and (ii)&nbsp;such documents as
are required to satisfy any applicable conditions precedent as provided in <U>Sections 6.1</U> (with respect to any Borrowing made on the Closing Date) and <U>6.2</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <B>Irrevocability of Requests for Borrowing</B>. Requests for Borrowings shall be irrevocable and binding on the Borrower,
and the Borrower shall indemnify each Lender against any loss or expense actually incurred by such Lender, either directly or indirectly, as a result of any failure by the Borrower to complete such Borrowing, including any loss or expense actually
incurred by any Agent or any Lender, either directly or indirectly by reason of the liquidation or reemployment of funds acquired by such Lender in order to fund such Borrowing, but excluding in each case loss of profit. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">43 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <B>Lender&#8217;s Commitment</B>. Notwithstanding anything contained in
this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.3(d)</U> or elsewhere in this Credit Agreement to the contrary, no Lender shall be obligated to provide the Administrative Agent or the Borrower with funds in connection with a Loan in an amount that would result
in the aggregate Loans then funded by it exceeding its Commitment then in effect. The obligation of each Lender to remit its Pro Rata Share of any such Loan requested of it shall be several from that of each other Lender, and the failure of any
Lender to so make such amount available to the Administrative Agent shall not relieve any other Lender of its obligation hereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <B>Defaulting Lender</B>. If, by 2:00 p.m. on any funding date, one or more Lenders fails to make its share of any Loan
available to the Administrative Agent pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.5</U> (the aggregate amount not so made available to the Administrative Agent being herein called the &#8220;<B><I>Loan Deficit</I></B>&#8221;), then the
Administrative Agent shall, by no later than 2:30 p.m. on the applicable funding date instruct each other Lender to pay, by no later than 3:00 p.m. on such date, in immediately available funds, to the Administrative Agent an amount equal to the
lesser of: (i)&nbsp;each other Lender&#8217;s proportionate share (based upon the relative Commitments of the other Lenders) of the Loan Deficit; and (ii)&nbsp;its unused Commitment. A Defaulting Lender shall forthwith, upon demand, pay to the
Administrative Agent for the ratable benefit of the other Lenders all amounts paid by each other Lender on behalf of such Defaulting Lender, together with interest thereon, for each day from the date a payment was made by each other Lender until the
date such other Lender has been paid such amounts in full, at a rate per annum equal to the Default Rate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)
<B>Rollovers</B>. No later than 12:00 noon (New York time) at least three (3)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the termination of each Interest Period (other than the Interest Period ending on the Stated Maturity Date) related to a Benchmark Rate Loan,
the Borrower shall give the Administrative Agent written notice at the Agency Services Address (which notice shall be via electronic mail) substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit F</U> attached hereto (the &#8220;<B><I>Rollover
Notice</I></B>&#8221;) whether it desires to renew such Benchmark Rate Loan. Each Rollover Notice shall be effective upon notification thereof to the Administrative Agent. Each Rollover Notice shall be irrevocable. If the Borrower fails to timely
give the Administrative Agent the Rollover Notice with respect to any Benchmark Rate Loan, the Borrower shall be deemed to have elected to renew such Loan as a Benchmark Rate Loan with an Interest Period of three (3)&nbsp;months commencing on the
expiration of the preceding Interest Period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) <B>Conversions</B>. The Borrower shall have the right, with respect to:
(i)&nbsp;any Alternate Base Rate Loan, on any Business Day (a &#8220;<B><I>Benchmark Conversion Date</I></B>&#8221;), to convert such Alternate Base Rate Loan to a Benchmark Rate Loan; and (ii)&nbsp;any Benchmark Rate Loan, on any Business Day (an
&#8220;<B><I>Alternate Base Rate Conversion Date</I></B>&#8221;) to convert such Benchmark Rate Loan to an Alternate Base Rate Loan if the Benchmark is unavailable pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.2</U> or <U>4.3</U>; <U>provided</U> that
the Borrower shall, on such Alternate Base Rate Conversion Date, make the payments towards accrued interest under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.3</U> and the payments required by <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.5</U>, if any; in either case, by
giving the Administrative Agent written notice at the Agency Services Address substantially in the form of <U>Exhibit F</U> attached hereto (a &#8220;<B><I>Conversion Notice</I></B>&#8221;) of such selection no later than 12:00 noon (New York time)
at least either (x)&nbsp;three (3) Business Days prior to such Benchmark Conversion Date, or (y)&nbsp;one (1) Business Day prior to such Alternate Base Rate Conversion Date, as applicable. Each Conversion Notice shall be effective upon notification
thereof to the Administrative Agent and shall be irrevocable. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">44 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
